title: edge-fix report
description: Output of `edge-fix --json`. A report is ALWAYS emitted, whatever the outcome. Safety contract: dry-run is the default, the input file is never modified in place, every applied change traces to a rule id with its evidence, and unmatched issues are reported — never guessed at. The re-lint improvement gate and the numerical verification result are both recorded; a rolled-back attempt keeps its after/improvement/verification blocks for transparency with output.written=false. The `summary` blocks are edge-lint summaries (lint_report.schema.json#/properties/summary).

litert_version.description: The matrix snapshot's litert_version — lint verdicts driving this fix are only valid for this runtime version.

rules_loaded.description: Rule ids loaded from rules_dir, sorted.

outcome.description: fixed: plan applied and the improvement gate passed (bytes written only in apply mode). no_improvement: automatic rollback — the re-lint metric did not improve. verification_failed: automatic rollback — numerics outside tolerance (never overridable by --allow-unverified). no_rules_matched: fixable findings exist but no rule matched. nothing_to_fix: no non-delegated findings and no io_cast match.

plan.description: Applied (or attempted) changes in deterministic order. Every item traces to a rule id and carries the rule's evidence and provenance.

conflicts.description: Targets claimed by more than one rule. Conflicted targets are left untouched — never resolved by a coin flip.

refused.description: Rules (or rule×node applications) the v1 engine cannot execute, with precise reasons (e.g. op_sequence matching, ops outside the options registry, recipe refs out of range).

unmatched_findings.description: Non-delegated findings no rule matched — reported, never guessed at.

io_changes.description: Graph interface dtypes before/after when the plan contains io_cast; null otherwise.

after.description: Re-lint of the rewritten graph; null when nothing was applied.

improvement.description: The re-lint gate verdict: delegated coverage first, then incorrect+crash count, then partition count; io_cast plans may instead improve the interface-violation count without regressing the lint metrics. null when nothing was applied.

status.description: passed/failed: measured on the LiteRT CPU interpreter (runners extra). skipped: the runners extra is unavailable. error: the interpreter could not execute one of the models.

tolerance.description: Pass bound per element: |out - ref| <= max(absolute, relative * |ref|) — the shared tolerance policy of the sweep and probe runners.

verification.description: Original vs fixed on seeded deterministic inputs via the LiteRT CPU interpreter. null when nothing was applied.

unverified.description: True when a fixed outcome was produced without a passed numerical verification (--allow-unverified with the runners extra unavailable). A failed verification is never marked unverified — it rolls back.

sha256.description: sha256 of the fixed model bytes; present whenever a fixed graph was produced, even in dry-run.

node_index.description: Original-graph node index for node actions; null for io_cast.

io_targets.description: Graph I/O tensors wrapped by an io_cast item; empty for node actions.
